scenes.title: The plan
scenes.vo: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.
scenes.cap: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: a website, never photograph it, never share it. No legitimate support team will ever ask for it. Compartmentalise: separate wallets by job, so a compromise only reaches one of them. First, Private key: the authority to sign. Whoever has it controls the funds. Next, Seed phrase: 12 to 24 words that recreate your keys. Never type it into. Then, Hardware wallet: keeps keys on a separate device. Signing requires physical confirmation. Also, Multisig: needs M of N signers (for example 2 of 3). Good for large or shared funds. And finally, Smart wallets: contract accounts that can add spending limits, recovery and batching.
scenes.cap: a website, never photograph it, never share it. No legitimate support team will ever ask for it. Compartmentalise: separate wallets by job, so a compromise only reaches one of them. First, Private key: the authority to sign. Whoever has it controls the funds. Next, Seed phrase: 12–24 words that recreate your keys. Never type it into. Then, Hardware wallet: keeps keys on a separate device. Signing requires physical confirmation. Also, Multisig: needs M of N signers (e.g. 2 of 3). Good for large or shared funds. And finally, Smart wallets: contract accounts that can add spending limits, recovery and batching.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: Move money down the chain (vault to operator to burner) only as needed, and sweep profits back up. If the burner gets drained, you lose only the burner's balance. Vault, Long-term holdings, Almost never. No DeFi approvals, Hardware (or multisig). Operator, Active DeFi positions, Known, verified protocols only, Hardware. Burner, Small amounts for new apps, mints, airdrops, Anything experimental, Hot wallet.

scenes.title: Checklist
items: Seed phrase stored offline, in two separate physical places
Vault wallet has never approved a DeFi contract
Separate burner wallet for anything new
I read every signing prompt on the hardware device screen, not just the website

scenes.q: A "support agent" in DMs needs your seed phrase to fix a stuck transaction. What do you do?
scenes.a: Nothing. It's a scam, every time. Block and report.

scenes.q: Why keep the vault wallet free of approvals?
scenes.a: Approvals let contracts move your tokens. With none, a compromised protocol can't reach it.
